compress_session_file: compress a model_responses session file and output a timestamped compressed version
extract_session_history: extract [USER]/[Agent] conversation history from a compressed L4 session file
batch_process_sessions: batch compress, extract, archive, and clean up L4 raw session files
merge_history_blocks: merge multiple sliding-window history blocks into one deduplicated conversation list
format_history_block: format extracted history lines into the all_histories.txt block format
